SELECT id, title, startDt, endDt, itemType, color, isRecurring, recurType, recurInterval, untilDt, recurGroupId /* 💡 반복 컬럼 추가 */ FROM ( SELECT EVENT_ID as id, TITLE as title, TO_CHAR(START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as startDt, TO_CHAR(END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as endDt, ITEM_TYPE as itemType, EVENT_COLOR as color, USER_ID, WS_ID, PROJ_ID, START_DT as RAW_START, END_DT as RAW_END, /* 💡 반복 관련 원본 데이터 추출 */ IS_RECURRING as isRecurring, RECUR_TYPE as recurType, RECUR_INTERVAL as recurInterval, TO_CHAR(RECUR_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as untilDt, RECUR_GROUP_ID as recurGroupId FROM EVENTS UNION ALL SELECT HLD_ID as id, HLD_NAME as title, TO_CHAR(HLD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD" 00:00:00"') as startDt, TO_CHAR(HLD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD" 23:59:59"') as endDt, 'HOLIDAY' as itemType, NULL as color, NULL as USER_ID, NULL as WS_ID, NULL as PROJ_ID, HLD_DATE as RAW_START, HLD_DATE as RAW_END, 'N', NULL, 1, NULL, NULL /* 휴일은 반복 데이터 없음 */ FROM NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS ) WHERE (
(itemType = 'PRIVATE' AND USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
(itemType = 'WS' AND WS_ID IN (SELECT WS_ID FROM WS_MEMBERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}))
(itemType = 'PROJ' AND PROJ_ID IN (SELECT PROJ_ID FROM PROJ_MEMBERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}))
(itemType = 'HOLIDAY') 1=0
1=0
) /* 💡 날짜 필터링 로직 수정 (반복 일정 대응) */ AND ( (isRecurring = 'N' AND RAW_START <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND RAW_END >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR (isRecurring = 'Y' AND (untilDt IS NULL OR TO_DATE(untilDt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) )
SELECT WS_ROLE FROM WS_MEMBERS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND EVENT_TYPE = 'WS'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS ( HLD_ID, HLD_DATE, HLD_NAME, IS_REST, COUNTRY ) VALUES ( SEQ_HLD_ID.NEXTVAL, TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYYMMDD'), #{title}, 'Y', 'KR' )

mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO EVENTS ( EVENT_ID, TITLE, START_DT, END_DT, PROJ_ID, WS_ID, USER_ID, ITEM_TYPE, EVENT_COLOR, IS_RECURRING, RECUR_TYPE, RECUR_INTERVAL, RECUR_END_DT, RECUR_GROUP_ID, IS_LUNAR, LUNAR_MONTH, LUNAR_DAY /* 💡 음력 컬럼 추가 */ ) VALUES ( SEQ_EVENT_ID.NEXTVAL, #{title}, TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), TO_DATE(#{endDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{wsId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{itemType}, #{color, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isRecurring, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{recurType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{recurInterval, jdbcType=NUMERIC},
TO_DATE(#{untilDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') NULL , #{recurGroupId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isLunar, jdbcType=CHAR}, /* 💡 추가 */ #{lunarMonth, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, /* 💡 추가 */ #{lunarDay, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 💡 추가 */ )
mapper.select: SELECT e.*, u.USER_NAME FROM EVENTS e JOIN USERS u ON e.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE e.PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND (e.IS_PRIVATE = 'N' OR e.USER_ID = #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE EVENTS SET START_DT = TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), END_DT = TO_DATE(#{endDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') WHERE EVENT_ID = #{id}

UPDATE EVENTS SET TITLE = #{title}, START_DT = TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), END_DT = TO_DATE(#{endDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), EVENT_COLOR = #{color}, RECUR_TYPE = #{recurType}, RECUR_INTERVAL = #{recurInterval}, RECUR_END_DT = TO_DATE(#{untilDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), IS_LUNAR = #{isLunar, jdbcType=CHAR}, LUNAR_MONTH = #{lunarMonth, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, LUNAR_DAY = #{lunarDay, jdbcType=NUMERIC} WHERE RECUR_GROUP_ID = #{recurGroupId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT w.WS_ID as "wsId", w.WS_NAME as "wsName" FROM WORKSPACES w JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm ON w.WS_ID = wm.WS_ID WHERE wm.USER_ID = #{userId}
